implementation_summary: Implemented rebuild-shared-chat-html.js which safely locates and extracts the streamController.enqueue JSON payload argument without executing arbitrary JavaScript, identifies deduplicated string slot references matching the target keys ('is_visually_hidden_from_conversation', 'is_redacted', 'hide_inline_actions'), retargets their boolean true references to a false slot while preserving shared slots and all other payload contents (including reasoning_recap_type='hide_all'), re-serializes the payload into the HTML preserving byte structure, and logs the execution summary.
assumptions: Input HTML contains the serialized streamController.enqueue call containing the flattened turbo-stream array payload.
Target keys are present in the string slot pool or object literal keys.
Slot retargeting to an existing or appended boolean false slot preserves turbo-stream decoding compatibility.
validation_notes: Retargets only the three specified keys and leaves non-target keys untouched.
Safely leaves reasoning_recap_type='hide_all' intact since it is a distinct key and string value.
Does not mutate shared true slots in place, preventing unintended side effects across unrelated properties.
Fails loudly with descriptive error messages if the payload or target keys are missing or if zero properties are updated.
